reviews.text: The accessories are very cute, and the people are very friendly.
A wide variety for your pets, plus good prices.
Excellent service! It's a unique concept where our pets are treated with the dignity they deserve.

One of the best dog spas I've ever been to. They offer a full service and you can choose your shampoo scent. Plus, their shop has really cute handmade items like leashes, collars, and more. I definitely recommend it.
We took our little dog here for grooming. They did a fantastic job and were so kind! We will come back here!
Excellent service from all staff, special recognition to Miss Gaby Valencia for her personalized attention, great variety of products and everything related to our canine children.

A super cute shop with awesome merchandise for dogs and cats 🐾. A Mexican company with great design 😍. Very friendly service.

P.S. They offer a 10% discount if your pet is adopted 💕🫶🏼.
Very good store, very nice details.

It's a beautiful shop, full of excellent pet products. The staff are lovely and even offer a tailoring service for dog clothes. All their products are tested by the owners and staff on their own pets, so they're guaranteed to be high quality. You can find toys you won't find anywhere else.

Hello, good day.

I'd like to share a concern regarding the scheduling process. Initially, I requested an appointment at 12:00 pm this week and was offered availability for the following week, which I accepted without issue. Later, I was shown available times starting at 10:00 am, and I again confirmed my preference for 12:00 pm; however, at that point, I was informed that it was no longer available and was offered 3:30 pm instead.

I found the change in availability a bit confusing, as there seemed to be several options, but the one I requested couldn't be arranged. Additionally, I requested a contact person for suggestions and shared this comment via WhatsApp, but I haven't received a response.

I would greatly appreciate your assistance in clarifying this situation so I can schedule more efficiently. Thank you.
We've been customers of Pero de Mundo for over 10 years. We love the quality of their products, the store is beautiful, and their staff is incredibly friendly.
If you love your pet, this place is for you
The best pet store in the area. They offer excellent products you won't find just anywhere. The service is always very attentive and personalized. Highly recommended.

I loved the grooming and bathing service. Dolly looked absolutely beautiful. The receptionist and groomer were kind and friendly, and they treated your dog very well. I give them a 100! You can also stop by the shop; they have a lovely vintage-style fitting room where you can take pictures of your little one modeling the clothes. The shop assistant there is also very nice. Highly recommended.
The best
A very nice little shop with original pet products

Beautiful dog boutique! If your dog is calm, I recommend bringing him inside. If not, you can leave him in the car and they'll let you go outside to try on clothes, or there's a fitting room, so you could just go straight there and take him in.

I say this because it's a small shop, there's a lot of merchandise, and not much room to walk around, so I'm mindful of everyone.
Just so you know, I have a large dog, and while she's not aggressive, she's protective and excessively friendly (and a bit rough, haha), so I prefer to leave her outside. I do take my little one inside.
I don't go often, but the products are very well made, designed with our furry friends and their comfort in mind. 🥰🥰🥰

The cutest store for your pets.

You'll find everything: toys, accessories, treats…
The clothes are beautiful and top quality, 100% Mexican design, and they even offer alterations 😌.
The service is always incredibly friendly.
The product selection is excellent.
The remodel looks amazing; there's a little mirror in the fitting room—a great spot for taking some great photos of your furry friend.
This store has been the discovery of the .es, it has everything you can imagine for your dog, great attention to detail and great service.
The best products and the best service
The dog clothes they have there fit perfectly, well made and with the right cut for pets.

The place is amazing, it's a real boutique for dogs with fitting rooms and everything! They have tons of products, even for big dogs like mine. Marisol's service is spectacular. I hope management recognizes her. I bought a coat for my best canine friend and got a discount from the brand because he's an adopted dog!

Thank you, Perro de Mundo! I'll keep visiting as often as I can!

Congratulations!

A spectacular store!!! You feel right at home.
The service and the warmth of the people who greet you are fantastic. I highly recommend it!
The best dog supplies and treats in the area. Always very friendly service.

Excellent!!! Wonderful saleswomen. Super friendly service with the dogs 🐶🐾🐾🐾. They have a variety of clothes and accessories to choose from... just be patient... they offer immediate solutions if you tell them the item is too small. Go!!! Arturito left very happy. Affordable prices. …
Kashi loves her new clothes. The designs and colors are so unique!

I love everything they have! They have beautiful things for dogs, and the quality is excellent. The best raincoats are here! The service is top-notch, and you can even try the clothes on your furry friend.
Wide variety of accessories for dogs.

They left my Shih Tzu with wounds all over his skin. A woman had told me her dog had caught a nasty fungus there, but I didn't believe her. It took four months for his wounds to heal... I spent a fortune on medicine. I don't recommend them.
A bit pricey, but some things are reasonably priced.
Excellent service and attention

I took my dog ​​for his monthly bath for at least two years, and we were both very happy. He went in calmly, without resisting, which is always a good sign. They always left him very clean, and the shampoos and products they use are natural and have hypoallergenic and fragrance-free options. The shop is very nice and has very good products, although it's not veterinary-focused; they sell toys, clothes, beds, treats, leashes, and harnesses. Customer service could be better, though; they weren't very attentive, even though we were frequent customers.
I loved it. The accessories are beautiful and the treats are definitely the best option for your pet.
Very nice and spacious place
Excellent products and excellent brands. Great prizes.
High-quality and super cool pet clothes.
I love this store! I always buy things for my dog ​​when I visit.
Good products and good service, you can tell they understand the needs of animals, highly recommended.

In the bathroom: Terrible service, rushed and unfriendly. The first time I took my puppy there, they tried to force her into the grooming area to have her nails trimmed without gaining her trust, greeting her, or anything. It was completely unprofessional. Obviously, I didn't leave her there, and we won't be back.
Amazing dog store! They have a huge variety of harnesses, clothes, beds, food, and leashes, in both styles and sizes.
They recently remodeled! And it looks amazing, it's the coolest dog shop in town

Without a doubt, it's one of my favorite places to pamper my pets. I find everything there, from sweaters they love for the cold weather to harnesses, collars, ID tags, treats, beds, blankets, basically everything you can imagine, and they treat us incredibly well.

A beautiful shop where you can find everything for your beloved dogs: toys, clothes, collars, leashes, treats, and other tasteful items.
The staff's service is always top-notch.

The service is sometimes good and sometimes bad. But for products in the more well-stocked stores with a wider variety of items, only go if you have a large budget because it's a bit pricey, but it's worth it.
